subject: Improve build script (#67)
reason: The change is purely a build and CI change: it rewrites build.sh argument handling, adds CMake options (BUILD_RELEASE, ENABLE_UNIT_TESTS, ENABLE_INTEGRATION_TESTS) to skip downloading Valkey and the test framework when not needed, splits the CI workflow into separate release/unit/integration/ASAN jobs, and updates the README. No module source file is touched; src/CMakeLists.txt only adds an include directory and a target dependency, and the build.sh switch to an explicit Release build type is a compile-configuration change with no behaviour change in the module's commands, replies, persistence
